name: Schematic Transit Map
description: Overlay schematic transit-network maps — tram, metro and light rail, commuter rail, and long-distance rail — in metro-map (octilinear), geographic, or radial layout. Rendered weekly from OpenStreetMap by LOOM (University of Freiburg) and proxied through this server.

loom-tiles.purpose: Schematic transit-network map tiles for the map overlay.
loom-tiles.dataSent: Map tile coordinates (zoom/x/y) and the selected network group and layout. Requests are made by the OpenMapX server, never directly by your browser.
loom-tiles.dataReceived: Vector map tiles containing transit lines and stations derived from OpenStreetMap.
